name: Alfeizar Invoices for LearnPress
author: José Manuel

sections.description:
Alfeizar Invoices for LearnPress lets you generate and send professional PDF invoices to your LearnPress students automatically — no WooCommerce, no extra e-commerce plugin, no added complexity. Install it, fill in your business details once, and every course order (free or paid via PayPal) gets its own numbered invoice, emailed straight to the student.

Perfect for independent teachers and small training academies who want to look professional and keep their bookkeeping in order, without paying for a full e-commerce stack they don’t actually need. Become a self-employed instructor without the overhead.

🟢 Features:

  • Automatic PDF invoice generation for every completed LearnPress order (free and paid courses)
  • Invoices emailed automatically to the student
  • Your logo, company name, tax ID and legal footer text on every invoice
  • Configurable tax name and percentage (VAT, IVA, or any tax you use)
  • Configurable currency format (symbol, decimal and thousands separators)
  • Sequential, unique invoice numbering (FAC-YYYY-NNNNNN)
  • Fully translatable, built following WordPress i18n best practices
  • Pro upgrade: searchable, filterable invoice list in your dashboard, with CSV export ready for your accountant or tax filing

sections.installation:
1. Upload the alfeizar-invoices folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure LearnPress is installed and active — this plugin requires it.
  4. Go to Invoices > Company Details in your dashboard and fill in your company name, tax ID, address, tax settings and currency format.
  5. That’s it — invoices will now be generated and emailed automatically whenever a LearnPress order is completed.
sections.faq:
Do I need to configure anything?

Yes, just once: go to Invoices > Company Details and fill in your company name, tax ID, address, the name and percentage of the tax you charge, and your preferred currency format. Everything else happens automatically from then on.

Do I need WooCommerce?

No. This plugin works entirely on top of LearnPress’s own order system — no e-commerce plugin required.

Does it work with free courses too?

Yes. Invoices are generated and sent for free course enrollments the same way as for paid ones.

I’m not receiving the invoice emails, what should I do?

This plugin sends emails using WordPress’s built-in wp_mail() function. Many hosting providers block or throttle outgoing mail by default. If invoices aren’t arriving, we recommend installing a dedicated SMTP plugin (such as Post SMTP, WP Mail SMTP, or similar) and configuring it with a real mail provider — this resolves delivery issues in the vast majority of cases.

What’s the difference between the free and Pro version?

The free version generates and sends unlimited PDF invoices automatically, forever, at no cost. The Pro upgrade adds a searchable, filterable invoice list inside your WordPress dashboard, plus CSV export — handy for your accountant or for tax filing purposes.

Can I use my own logo?

Yes, the plugin automatically uses the logo set under Appearance > Customize > Site Identity.
